card.name: The "is" after "to do"
card.fires_on: The linking verb "is" or "was" right after a phrase ending in "do", as in "All you have to do is" or "The first thing to do is". It then introduces the action or step.

modes.label: Instruction lead-in
modes.description: "is" after "have to do", "need to do" or "thing to do", introducing a step.
modes.example: All you have to do<< is>>… Place the cursor within the heading text

modes.label: What someone does
modes.description: "is" or "was" after "do" in a cleft sentence about what someone does or did.
modes.example: you had to do<< was>> pop the film cassette into the camera,

card.plain: It fires on the word "is" in phrases like "all you have to do is", just before the step is named.
